name: vos3-sovereignty
description: VOS3 kernel sovereignty primitives as MCP tools. Provides transparency (MMR audit chain), attestation (X-VOS3-Attestation), isolation (slot ZOMBIE quarantine), and routing decisions to any MCP-compatible client.

documentation.rationale: MCP won the universal AI driver standard war. VOS3 cannot afford to be locked out of an ecosystem with 10,000+ MCP servers under Linux Foundation governance. This bridge surfaces VOS3's sovereignty primitives to that ecosystem with no native dependency.
